review_scope: Maker individual image inspection, not independent acceptance
observation_method: Maker personally opens each of32 separately rendered512px final frames using view_image; contact sheets reviewed additionally, never substituted for individual inspection.

inspected_frames.observation: Open scrambling axes and narrow node whorls; wedge leaves have incised tips, not broad fern fronds. Roots and hooks restrained.
Reverse quarter confirms distributed laterals and no obvious detached leaf bases.
Leaves are naturally near edge-on in this elevation; jointed axes remain readable.
Depth-separated axes overlap but branch bases remain joined.
Reverse elevation confirms no arbitrary central mass or invented cone.
Six-leaf radial whorls, wedges and narrow divided leaves clearly visible; no large circular leaf plates.
Geometry-only rendering retains whorls and root attachment without painted texture.
Sparse angular habit and negative spaces retained, no oversized hook silhouette.

concept_comparison: Identifying form retained; geometry intentionally simpler and palette-only, not painted ImageGen texture. Original brief unchanged.
known_limitations: Illustrative scale and reconstruction; not measured site or specimen.

Sphenophyllum and Psaronius whole habits are hypotheses; Psaronius is genus-level. Hausmannia and Dictyophyllum are isolated fossil organs, not whole plants. Counts, color and scale are illustrative; no reproductive microanatomy claim.
CPU stills and Node parse are not hardware GPU or composed-scene evidence.
